::: {.callout-warning}
## Venue details require confirmation

The information below describes the 2025 meeting at UCLA. Do not make travel
plans for the next meeting until its venue and date are announced.
:::

## 2025 meeting location

The 2025 conference was held at UCLA in Kaplan Hall A51 (Auditorium), with
poster sessions and lunch in Powell Courtyard between Kaplan Hall and Powell
Library.

- [UCLA campus map: Kaplan Hall](https://www.maps.ucla.edu/?id=2043#!ct/75713?m/696758?s/kaplan)
- [Kaplan Hall A51 entrance](https://goo.gl/maps/7saGrAC7VZEVX13E7?g_st=aw)

## Parking

Parking Structure 2 was the closest recommended visitor parking area in 2025.
Structures 4 and 5 were alternatives, although they required a walk uphill.
Visitors were instructed to use unmarked stalls and purchase a permit at a pay
station or through ParkMobile.

Parking prices and payment rules change. Consult [UCLA Transportation](https://transportation.ucla.edu/)
for current information rather than relying on archived rates.

## Public transportation

UCLA and Westwood were served by several systems in 2025:

| Provider | Useful routes or service |
|---|---|
| [LA Metro](https://www.metro.net/) | Wilshire, Sunset, and Sepulveda service to UCLA/Westwood |
| [Santa Monica Big Blue Bus](https://www.bigbluebus.com/) | Connections from Santa Monica, the E Line, Marina del Rey, and the VA |
| [Culver CityBus](https://www.culvercitybus.com/) | Line 6 and Rapid 6 via Sepulveda Boulevard |
| [UCLA BruinBus](https://transportation.ucla.edu/getting-around-campus/bruinbus) | Campus and Westwood shuttle service |

Routes and schedules should be checked directly with each provider before
travel.

## Lodging near UCLA

Options listed for the 2025 meeting included:

- [The Inn at UCLA](https://theinn.ucla.edu/)
- [UCLA Meyer & Renee Luskin Conference Center](https://luskinconferencecenter.ucla.edu/)
- [W Los Angeles – West Beverly Hills](https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/laxwb-w-los-angeles-west-beverly-hills/overview/)
- [Royal Palace Westwood Hotel](https://www.royalpalacewestwood.com/)
- [Palihotel Westwood Village](https://www.palisociety.com/hotels/westwood-village)

These are reference listings, not endorsements or reserved conference room
blocks.
